hypothesis: EM-BP's reported errors do not depend on selecting the checkpoint with the true score: selection by held-out one-view log-evidence gives the same test risk within seed noise.
design: E02a cells replicated exactly (bundle tags exp31-*, init tag exp31-em-init, protocol-2 ladder to 1200, C = 8) at M = 32 (16 seeds) and M = 512 (seeds 0-3); at every checkpoint the oracle validation risk, the held-out one-view log-evidence per edge (validation chains, tags 'e20-split'/'e20-noise') and the test risk; test risk under each rule and at the last rung.
predeclared_analysis: Paired difference of the test risk between the two rules per size; the fraction of cells where the two rules pick the same rung.
motivation: Registered during the 18-19 September audit (reports/audit-2026-09-18.tex); the scratch computation that motivated it was run first on the laptop and is reproduced here under provenance.
